verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Ashby includes a Scheduling module in its all-in-one platform ([ashby-docs-30]) and emits webhooks for interview scheduling events ([ashby-docs-6]). Nothing in the pack describes automatic scheduling of multi-interviewer panels or full onsite loops. missing for 10: evidence of automated panel/onsite loop scheduling, interviewer load balancing, room booking, conflict resolution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling quality.
